answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide strategy and is not described as including research associates.
Budget planning involves office holders of higher rank due to the university-wide plan.
The appointment committee deals with professorships and does not include research associates.
The faculty council decides on faculty affairs and is led by the dean, excluding research associates by default.
The study commission prepares degree programme changes and advises the faculty council, without research associate membership.
The examination board decides on individual student examination matters and does not include research associates.
The research associate works on a doctorate and assists in research, but is not stated to be a member of the internal research funding round.
Module revision involves rewriting descriptions, which is not part of the research associate's stated duties.
Laboratory equipment procurement is outside the research associate's role of assisting in research and teaching.
Orientation week planning is for new students and is not part of the research associate's responsibilities.
